producer: Primary DINOv2-L/14 runs (11 pools x seeds 0-9) and local-removal runs (4 arms x seeds 4-9, 14-17)
equivalence_check: On reduced CPU inputs with the real DINOv2 classes, primary.py/local.py and the archived producers give identical trainable tensors (85), RNG state, losses and epoch metrics over four epochs. This is not a GPU bitwise check.
changes_from_archived_producers: One shared module with primary/local recipe selection; local keeps macro-F1 over the union of true and predicted labels, primary over represented true labels.
Local DINOv2 source and dataset roots from environment variables; optional explicit frozen weights for inference.
Strict CSV input validation; row order, duplicates and class mapping preserved.
Checkpoint recipe metadata and strict key/shape/dtype checks; saved tensors unchanged.
Output-path safety and provenance fields; CPU runs disable autocast (CUDA runs keep FP16 autocast and gradient scaling).

primary_campaign.gpu: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB, one visible device per fit

local.gpu: one A100-SXM4-80GB, RTX A6000 or L40S per seed
